title: Awesome Tour!
text: My family had the most incredible day! Our tour guide Joan was very professional, kind, knowledgeable, and accommodating! The beach and all the sights were beautiful and amazing. I highly recommend this tour to anyone and will do it again when we return!
author: Christopher_V

title: Discovering the South of Spain
text: The weather was too windy but the view was great.  We had lunch  in Jerez de la Frontera snd Vejer de la Frontera.  Beautiful towns.
author: Patricia_H

title: Local beaches near Sevilla
text: We had a private tour with Not Just A Tourist company from Sevilla.  Our tour guide was Aitor.  Our guide was very knowledgeable and flexible and took us to the local beaches so we could avoid some of the touristy spots.   Not only were they beautiful but also you got a sense of the local community.  Overall a wonderful day and a definite must do!
author: nt2019sevilla

title: A splendid day
text: Had a wonderful day with our excellent guide, Aitor. He was friendly and knowledgeable and took us to places we would never have discovered on our own. By the end of the day, it was like spending time with a friend. We can thoroughly recommend the trip and Aitor.
author: 379richard

title: Javier are tour guide was great. We...
text: Javier are tour guide was great. We didn't feel rushed and were able to see everything at our pace. I highly recommend this tour. The driver was also excellent. Worth the price all around.
author: Carlos_A
